name: How much does it cost to build a tiny home for rental purposes?
description: Costs for a rental tiny home vary based on size, materials, and site work, generally ranging from $100,000 to $200,000+ for a fully equipped ADU.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a tiny home for rental purposes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a tiny home for rental varies significantly based on factors like size, materials, finishes, foundation type (e.g., on-slab, raised), and site preparation. Custom ADU tiny homes, which are common for rentals, involve design, permits, utility connections, and construction. While a basic shell might start lower, a fully equipped, ready-to-rent unit in our service areas of Vista, Oceanside, Carlsbad, and San Marcos typically ranges from $100,000 to $200,000+. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation.
